prior_results_seen: The native-cost QM-HPF-like v4 and QGPF-like audits have already been inspected. This plan was set before this new cached fair-budget run, and is not preregistration of the paper or confirmatory research.
question: Under a maximum of 200 likelihood evaluations per step in the source-inspired one-dimensional Gaussian model, how do the fixed QM-HPF-like heuristic and a normative fixed-ancestor resample-move compare with a 200-particle bootstrap PF?
qm_low_schedule: generation-major round robin; at most 100 candidates per step; at most 20 per low particle; strict ESS weight threshold; no force-filling or dummy calls
qm_encoding: 16-bit deterministic encoding over [-10,10]; reconstruct bit state each proposal; rotation schedule 0.04pi to 0.01pi; source-inspired heuristic not persistent amplitude representation
qm_acceptance: likelihood-only accept min(1,Lnew/Lold); reweight with weight * Lfinal/Linitial; no posterior-invariance or valid general importance correction claim
common_estimate_timing: weighted mean after prediction and weighting, before resampling/move
budget: 200 scalar likelihood evaluations upper cap per step; bootstrap 200 base; RM100 base+100 proposed; QMl ike100 base+at most100 proposed; cached old likelihoods; if fewer candidates available report actual counts
statistics: paired mean difference, two-sided Student-t95CI, paired dz, 10000-draw paired-seed percentile bootstrap CI; Holm family correction across two paired t tests
randomness: shared truth/observations rng(seed); independent algorithm rng(seed+1000003*(method_index+1))
exclusions: none; preserve every failure and halt on numerical invalidity; never drop seed or outlier
stopping: exactly30 seeds times3 methods, no tuning or extensions based on outcome
scope: single synthetic Gaussian model; no general quantum-method ranking; no quantum speedup; no equivalence claim from non-significant contrasts
failure_rule: stop on invalid finite/normalization/cap tests; retain failure artifact; underused QM cap is not a failure or exclusion
authorization: User requested implementation check and fair-comparison supplement; local CPU execution only
